segments.text: The goal is the manpage3 password, from /manpage/manpage2: a getpass-style check against a file, then setuid getuid and an execl where argv zero is the executable and argv one is a marker byte.
The trick is that the binary launches whatever argv zero names.
I log in as manpage two, read the source, and launch the level with the executable set to /manpage/manpage2 but argv zero set to /bin/sh, with the marker byte as argv one.
I plant a script file first: after one wrong guess the binary execs /bin/sh with the marker, which is my script.
The script seeks fd three back to zero and reads it, dumping the password.
